name: IngestErrorAndStatusContracts
description: Stable safe workflow errors, append-only durable error events, batch status projections, and opaque snapshot cursor contracts.
schema_def: IngestError {code, category: usage|validation|unsupported|unsafe_source|compatibility|permission|resource|reconciliation|overlap|ledger|interrupted|conflict|unexpected, safeMessage, batchId?, candidateId?, mutationPossibility: none|possible|confirmed, durableState?, retryAction: none|retry|repreview|resume|abandon|correct_source, field?}

BatchErrorEvent {errorEventId, batchId, sequence, code, category, safeMessage, candidateId?, mutationPossibility, durableState?, retryAction, field?, recordedAt}; append-only; complete safe metadata is written atomically with the workflow transition and latest sequence is lastStableError.
BatchStatusSummary {batchId, status, adapterId?, createdAt, updatedAt, outcomeCounts, nextAllowedOperations[]}
BatchStatusDetail {summary, manifestRevisionId?, approved, receiptStatus?, terminalCounts, unresolvedFrontier, lastStableError?, retainedArtifactKinds[]}

IngestStatusCursorPayload {cursorVersion: 1, contractVersion, snapshotId, nextOrdinal, pageSize: 1..100, storeGeneration, expiresAt}; opaque base64url public value validated against the stored header.

StatusSnapshot {snapshotId, contractVersion, storeGeneration, createdAt, expiresAt, totalCount}; ephemeral metadata-only query state. StatusSnapshotItem {snapshotId, ordinal, batchStatusSummaryJson}; immutable membership ordered by updatedAt descending then batchId.

Errors and status snapshots never contain source paths, statement rows, descriptions, amounts, balances, full bank identifiers, requests, manifests, stack traces, or parser exceptions. Exit categories mirror the shared Tally contract; structured code remains authoritative.
